If F-2: 2 h to assembly, care and residential uses (NBC Table 3.1.3.1)

HVAC separate from the hall; above the 500-year flood level (FM 5-28, insurer guidance)
2 h room kept (NFPA 855, US standard; stricter than FM's 1 h)
